def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants - normalize case and fix typos
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo'})
    # Convert body_mass_g from text with commas to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate mean body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
